name: Hexatriacontane
description: Hexatriacontane (CAS 630-06-8 ) is a long-chain saturated hydrocarbon wax used as a lubricant and processing aid in polymer and industrial formulations. Its high molecular weight and waxy solid character make it suitable for applications where controlled melt behavior is required. In plastics processing, this compound functions as an external lubricant and mold release agent, reducing friction between polymer melts and metal surfaces during extrusion and injection molding. It is used as a plasticizer and softener in specialty polymer compounds. This high-carbon paraffin is often preferred over shorter-chain alternatives in specific industrial settings. In lubricant formulations, it serves as a base component or additive in high-temperature greases and solid lubricant blends. Researchers and formulators also use it as a reference standard hydrocarbon when characterizing wax composition or calibrating analytical methods. It provides consistent performance in laboratory environments where precise chemical properties are essential. The product is supplied as a white to off-white waxy solid, typically in flake, powder, or block form. It is available in technical grade for industrial processing applications and in higher-purity grades suited to laboratory and specialty use. Purity specifications commonly range from technical-grade material to 97–99%+ for research and analytical applications.
